scope: Source-constrained Fog-GPCR-integrin-mechanics recruitment model; all force thresholds are conditional model results, not biological estimates.

claims.exact_statement: In the discrete serial no-bypass relay with per-cell detachment reserve Delta_i = alpha*(M0 + Gamma*O_i*I_i/(K+I_i))*sin(theta_i) - beta*B_i and the constitutive rule that cell i detaches iff Delta_i>0, propagation through N rows occurs if and only if min_i Delta_i>0.
assumptions: Cells are arranged in a serial propagation path with no bypass or long-range recruitment around a stalled row.
Detachment occurs exactly when quasi-static normal de-adhesion force exceeds adhesion load.
Force closures F_deadh=alpha*M and F_adh=beta*B hold over the modeled regime.
O, I, B, theta and coefficients are well-defined state variables; no mapping from published fluorescence proxies to these quantities is assumed.
claims.status: internally_proved_exact_conditional_discrete_model_result; not validated as the embryo force law
claims.novelty_boundary: The induction is elementary and exact only for the named serial force-threshold model. The biological roles of integrin, MyoII, contact and detachment are source-reported prior findings; no literature priority claim is made for weakest-link propagation generally.

costs.supplied: Source-reported pathway topology and contact/de-adhesion mechanism.
must_acquire: cell-linked O_i and active I_i rather than uncalibrated brightness proxies
B_i, theta_i and per-cell force or detachment-reserve calibration
costs.computation: O(N) force-margin evaluation after states and coefficients are measured.
costs.experimental_resources: Custom reporters/perturbations, staged embryo live tracking, force or detachment calibration, embryo-level replication; monetary and energy costs not available in cited sources.

claims.falsifier: Repeated detachment and downstream propagation through cells with independently calibrated Delta_i<=0, or reliable propagation around a nonpositive row, falsifies the constitutive serial model.
claims.next_gate: Measure per-cell force reserve and test whether min_i Delta_i predicts held-out cell detachment and embryo propagation.

claims.exact_statement: Under B=I and fixed O, theta with Delta(I)=alpha*sin(theta)*(M0+Gamma*O*I/(K+I))-beta*I, the marginal effect of integrin changes sign exactly at O_c=beta*(K+I)^2/(alpha*Gamma*K*sin(theta)); for fixed O, an interior reserve maximizer is I*=sqrt(alpha*Gamma*O*K*sin(theta)/beta)-K when positive.
assumptions: Integrin state I has both a saturating cofactor effect on contractility and an adhesive load proportional to I.
MyoII-to-deadhesion force and adhesion-load coefficients are locally constant.
Receptor input O and detachment angle theta are held fixed while I is titrated.
alpha, beta, Gamma, K and active I/O units are positive and calibrated.
claims.novelty_boundary: A conditional consequence of a proposed dual-role integrin closure, not evidence that nature follows this saturation law. The qualitative cofactor and adhesion roles are prior art; intervention novelty and external priority are unknown.

must_acquire: matched active receptor state and active integrin titration
costs.computation: Closed-form threshold and optimum after parameter acquisition.
costs.experimental_resources: Factorial perturbation/genotype cohorts and embryo-level tracking; no experiment performed and currency/instrument-time costs unestimated.

claims.falsifier: With force-calibrated states and geometry controlled, a single-sign dDelta/dI across an adequately sampled range, absent the predicted saturation/sign crossing, falsifies this closure.
claims.next_gate: Estimate force reserve over graded integrin at fixed receptor activity and stratified theta; test the sign switch before claiming any speed effect.

claims.exact_statement: If N cell reserves are iid Normal(mu,sigma^2) under the serial criterion, the probability of propagation is Phi(mu/sigma)^N, and target failure probability epsilon requires mu/sigma >= Phi^{-1}((1-epsilon)^(1/N)); at epsilon=0.05 this is 2.4421108 for N=7 and 2.7992115 for N=20.
assumptions: Per-cell force reserves are identically distributed Gaussian with common mean and variance.
The deterministic serial criterion C9-M1 applies.
claims.status: exact_conditional_probability_identity_and_finite_arithmetic; iid Gaussian assumptions are not source-established
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard order-statistic probability under an explicitly imposed iid normal model; no empirical claim about embryo margin distributions.

costs.computation: Closed form plus scalar normal quantile; Python standard-library check reproduced the listed values.
costs.experimental_resources: Same per-cell force/geometry acquisition as C9-M1; sample-size calculation requires pilot embryo-level variance.

claims.falsifier: Non-Gaussian or spatially dependent reserves invalidate the product formula; use a measured joint lower-tail model instead.
claims.next_gate: Do not use the numerical z-threshold operationally unless iid normality is supported; measure spatial dependence first.

claims.exact_statement: A single front-relative exponential profile does not identify active-pool transport: for constant v, the same profile P(d)=b+(A-b)exp(-d/ell) is generated by a no-lateral-transport contact-age waveform M(a)=b+(A-b)exp(-(Delta-a)/tau) with a=Delta-d/v and tau=ell/v. Therefore profile length and cross-paper D/v values alone cannot identify a biological Fog-dose, mobility, or clearance threshold.
assumptions: The front-relative profile is observed over a finite range with monotone distance-to-contact-age mapping.
A local contact-age response may vary across the observed age window.
The published summaries do not pair calibrated active-pool mobility, clearance, cell-age history, force state and speed in the same condition.
claims.novelty_boundary: Coordinate reparameterization is elementary. Its value is a bounded inference warning and restart gate, not a novel theorem about all source observations.

costs.existing_information: Source-reported exponential profiles, FCS pool summaries and perturbation directions.
missing_information: same-cell contact age and front speed
active-pool mobility and clearance in the cell material frame
matched receptor activity, integrin/contact and force measures
costs.computation: Exact waveform/profile substitution; no fitting or raw data required.

claims.falsifier: The alias does not claim to fit all unaggregated trajectories; it is beaten if same-cell contact-age traces fail to predict held-out profiles while independently measured transport parameters predict them better.
claims.next_gate: Compare passive transport, contact-age, and Fog-gated mechanical-relay models on held-out doses and integrin states with equal measurement access.

claims.exact_statement: Mundhe et al. (2026) report near-normal initiation but about 2.5 versus 7.1 rows after primordium-only G-alpha rescue; diffusible primordium Fog rescue gives about 5.3 rows versus about 1.7 for source-confined tethered Fog. They report a near-uniform extracellular Fog signal, fast/slow apical FCS components, and integrin-dependent MyoII output while Smog brightness is retained after integrin loss.
assumptions: Claims are limited to the experimental conditions, constructs and measurements reported in the primary paper.
FCS slow-pool identity, Smog brightness-to-oligomer inference, and active force states remain proxies/inferences as described by the authors.
claims.status: source_reported_external_primary_observations; no raw image or source-data refit performed
claims.novelty_boundary: These are source-paper findings, not discoveries in this cycle. 2018 GPCR clustering/endocytic prior art and the 2019/2024 mechanical relay sharply limit novelty claims.

costs.source_access: Primary articles, 2026 supplement and transparent review were read; no raw microscopy data were reanalyzed.
costs.future_acquisition: Matched embryo-level mobility, contact, activity, force and speed measures remain outstanding.

claims.falsifier: A matched replication with sustained propagation absent PZ Fog/GPCR input, or equal propagation from source-confined tethered Fog under matched initial invagination, would challenge the stated necessity in those conditions.
claims.next_gate: Use the published rescue/tether controls and 2019/2024 mechanical relay as comparators in any new parameterized experiment.

claims.exact_statement: The pinned 2025 skull-wave simulator initializes a shallow phenotype tail q0=0.005333 per micron, versus qstar=0.061637 per micron under a homogeneous A-homeostatic scalar KPP reduction. The released output replay gives 21.7353 microns/hour for the interpolated phi-half line and 10.8082 microns/hour after local drift removal. In that scalar comparator, a single adjusted speed cannot identify alpha when q is unknown: multiple positive (q,alpha) pairs reconstruct the same speed.
assumptions: Scalar reduction assumes constant leading-edge density and uniform advection; it is not the full nonlinear source PDE.
The replay analyzes released Mathematica output CSVs and does not rerun or converge the solver.
The speed-to-alpha counterexample is conditional on the standard shallow-tail Fisher-KPP branch.
claims.status: finite_source_output_replay_plus_constructive_nonidentifiability_in_conditional_model; biological propagation law and alpha remain UNKNOWN
claims.novelty_boundary: Fisher-KPP tail selection and the algebraic nonidentifiability are standard. This audit makes no claim of a new biological propagation mechanism or a nature-level parameter estimate.

costs.computation: Sub-second Python/NumPy replay with local SHA-256 and pinned Git blob verification.
missing_observations: held-out front speed after alpha fitting
matched live front speed under BAPN stiffness perturbation

claims.falsifier: A source-exact converged full-PDE replay or measured live q and held-out speed can change the model-output branch diagnosis or remove the one-speed nonidentifiability if the missing inputs are fixed.
claims.next_gate: Reproduce the exact nonlinear solver under grid/time refinement, predeclare the front-speed estimand, independently measure q and material-frame drift, then validate alpha against a held-out condition.

failures_and_unknowns.statement: No source-derived numerical Fog-dose, receptor-clearance, mobility, integrin, or force threshold is identifiable from profile lengths and cross-paper parameter proxies.

The measured slow Fog FCS component is presumed membrane/receptor-associated but is not chemically established as the active signal, and its D is not established as active-state material-frame mobility.

The two-gate law assumes a quasi-static peel threshold, linear force closures, a saturating integrin cofactor, and a serial no-bypass relay; biology may require viscoelasticity, stochastic bond rupture, multiple mechanical paths, distributed forcing, or a different constitutive law.
The iid Gaussian reliability values are illustrative conditional calculations, not estimates of embryo reliability; cell-level correlations and non-Gaussian tails are unknown.
No empirical integrin sign-switch has been observed; the local derivative changes sign only within the proposed dual-role closure and requires matched receptor input, angle, and calibrated force.

The scalar skull-wave reduction is not the full moving-density force-balanced PDE; its shallow-tail speed match is a finite model-output diagnostic only, while nature-level q, alpha, and propagation remain unknown.

validation.result: PASS; finite algebra fixtures only; no biological data fit or external proof validation
